dishes.name: Tarteletter
dishes.desc: Puff pastry shells filled with chicken and asparagus in white sauce. A Danish classic that is easy to find on Funen.

dishes.name: Odense marzipan
dishes.desc: Marzipan figures, bars and sweets made in the city, which has a long tradition of confectionery.

dishes.name: Funen apple cake
dishes.desc: Funen is the orchard island of Denmark, and apple cakes and desserts feature on cafe menus across the island.

dishes.name: Risalamande
dishes.desc: Cold rice pudding with whipped cream, almonds and hot cherry sauce. Danish Christmas dessert that appears on winter menus.

dishes.name: Fynsk rullepølse
dishes.desc: Spiced pressed pork roll sliced thin over rye bread, a regular on the Danish cold lunch table.
